LanguageData.MC_InstallDesc: Install an upgrade module from your stores into this mech, or take one out. A mech holds up to 3 modules.
LanguageData.MC_NoneOnMap: none on the map (make it at the fabrication bench)
LanguageData.MC_Retreat: {0} is badly damaged and leaves the fight.
LanguageData.MC_ColorRadius: Own colour for each mechanitor's command radius
LanguageData.MC_ColorRadiusDesc: With several mechanitors on one map, each one's command radius is drawn in its own colour so you can tell them apart. The first mechanitor keeps the game's white.
LanguageData.MC_RemoteControl: Mechs stay controllable when the mechanitor is away
LanguageData.MC_RemoteControlDesc: While the mechanitor travels in a caravan or is on another map, his mechs can still be drafted and given orders anywhere on their map. He must be alive, conscious, free and sane, and the mech must be within his bandwidth. Mechs are still undrafted when he leaves – draft them again. Off = the game's rules.
